20260708002: The Department of Sanitation proposes rules for the commercial waste zones program and its implementation schedule. Authority: Sections 753 and 1043(g) of the New York City Charter and Section 16-120 of the New York City Administrative Code authorize DSNY to make this rule. The proposed rule amends 16 RCNY § 1-01 and amends New York City Administrative Code § 16-120.
20260605008: The Department of Sanitation adopts rules for the commercial waste zones program and its implementation schedule. Authority: Section 753 of the New York City Charter and Section 16-120 of the New York City Administrative Code authorize DSNY to make this rule. The adopted rule amends 16 RCNY § 1-01 and amends New York City Administrative Code § 16-120.
dot-proposed: Authority: Section 2903(a) of the New York City Charter. The proposed rule adds 34 RCNY § 4-12(q).
dcwp-adopted: Authority: Section 2203 of the New York City Charter. The adopted rule repeals 6 RCNY § 2-317.
external-ambiguous: The agency amends its rules and references 42 U.S.C. § 1983 and State law. A number resembling 16-120 appears in a table without a corpus label or effect statement.
